description: The local policy (SEC-10 to SEC-14) against a valid compiled config: `{ok: true}`, `policy_violation` (the config goes beyond the policy — the bundle is rejected, SEC-11) or `policy_invalid` (the policy file itself is malformed; the gate serves nothing). Hosts are keyed as `host[:port]`; a path prefix matches the same path or a path continuing at a "/" boundary. `pull` (optional, DT-11) is the one place the gate fetches new bundles from by itself: `https://host[:port]/path` to a file (lower-case host, path segments of letters, digits, `.`, `_`, `~` and `-` but no `.` or `..` segment, at most 2048 characters), at most every `intervalSeconds` (60 to 86 400).
